text:
sam-docs: Drafting release notes for the embeddings behavior tweak: the `trim_short_inputs` boolean is being replaced with `min_input_tokens` (int) to give finer control. Putting draft snippets, migration checklist, and linkfix notes here for quick review before I open the PR.

veronica-product: good — add a short customer impact blurb and the canary window. Also request a one-paragraph "what to do" for Support to send to affected customers.

lee-eng: runtime notes: please mention runtime >= v1.4.3 required for the new header and that empty inputs are still rejected (400). Also note that Dedicated canary pool will remain on the old behavior for 48 hours after publish.

sam-docs: JS migration snippet (old -> new):
```js
// old
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1', input: ['hi'], options: { trim_short_inputs: true } });

// new
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1', input: ['hi'], options: { min_input_tokens: 1 } });
```

gina-sdk: SDK nuance: JS uses camelCase `minInputTokens` in client options, REST uses `min_input_tokens`. Python example below. Note supported SDK versions: js >=1.2.4, py >=0.9.5.

sam-docs: Python snippet:
```py
# new explicit
resp = client.embeddings.create(
    model='open-embed-1',
    input=['hi'],
    options={'min_input_tokens': 1}
)
```

harry-support: Support note: two active tickets reported regressions when customers relied on implicit trimming. I'll prepare a template: short summary, steps to check, and rollback instructions (pin model runtime or set min_input_tokens=0). Ticket references: #8460, #8461.

veronica-product: add perf callout: enabling `min_input_tokens=1` preserves expected embedding counts but increases token transmission slightly; include approximate delta (~+4%) and link to internal measurement (internal URL). That will help customers weigh tradeoffs.

sam-docs: added perf stat and a short migration checklist in the relnote: 1) upgrade SDK to supported versions 2) replace `trim_short_inputs` with `min_input_tokens` or `minInputTokens` 3) run integration tests and inspect embeddings counts 4) pin runtime >= v1.4.3 if you depend on empty-input rejection 5) roll canary at <3% traffic.

lee-eng: small wording nit: prefer `inputs under 2 tokens` instead of 'single-token' in docs copy. Also mention how to detect affected cases using the Console token histogram.

sam-docs: updated wording. Also fixed two broken anchors discovered during linking pass: the model catalog anchor changed from `#embed-models` to `#models-embeddings` and a cross-ref in the migration guide pointed to the old anchor. Added redirects in the PR.

gina-sdk: one more SDK detail: add a short grep/sed helper in the docs repo examples to automate rename: `git grep -l "trim_short_inputs" | xargs sed -i 's/trim_short_inputs/min_input_tokens/g'`. I'll paste that in the PR.

deploy-bot: sam-docs pushed branch sam/embed-min-input-relnotes -> staging/docs (CI: passing) :white_check_mark:

sam-docs: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7712 

Contains snippets, migration checklist, support template, sed helper, and redirects for two broken anchors. I'll merge after one more docs sign-off and schedule the relnote publish for Fri 08:00 PT.

harry-support: once merged, I'll send the Support template to the team and start contacting customers with heavy embedding pipelines.

veronica-product: marketing will prepare the What's New blurb and a short in-product notice for customers on older SDKs.

sam-docs: thanks all. tagging @gina-sdk and @lee-eng for final thumbs. Will post back with the live publish timestamp after merge. Closing thread for now.
